newsitem.title: USA: El Paso sees N.M. Chaco plant back Friday.
newsitem.headline: El Paso sees N.M. Chaco plant back Friday.

text.p: El Paso Natural Gas Co said Thursday it will return to service its Chaco gas processing plant in New Mexico on Friday morning as scheduled.
The maintenance outage affected about 300-500 million cubic feet per day of supply.
In addition, the pipeline is doing maintenance at several downstream locations, a company spokeswoman said.
At the Belen station in New Mexico, production will continue to be cut by about 70 mmcfd through Sunday, she said.
